decisions.reason: It builds on the core offer, has a quantified customer saving claim, and after two years on the website management is likely to justify and continue the investment rather than admit a mistake.

Although there is no explicit performance proof on the website, it remains on its own page across two years and is close to the established business, so a growing German machinery firm would likely persist with it.

As a flagship multi-model line tied to the firm’s stated direction and backed by a named customer case and strong savings claim, it carries high public commitment and is very unlikely to be withdrawn.
This is a newly launched multi-model line close to the firm’s core shredding offer, and management can easily treat any weak early traction as temporary while defending the recent investment.

Despite limited market evidence so far, it is a new multi-model extension of the established portfolio and the firm’s growth and innovation posture make continued commitment more likely than a quick exit.
